授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: What is consciousness? How does the brain process information for perception; memory; et cetera. These questions can be looked at from many angles: psychology; neuroscience; and medicine. The goal of this course is to address these questions in an openminded and creative way; using scientific methods. We will focus on the basic principles of brain structure and function; the current trends in research and the importance of this field for society and well-being.
